definitions: A heavy or bulky thing that is being carried or is to be carried.
The amount of work to be done by a person or machine.
A large number or amount of people or things.
The amount of electric power delivered or required at any specific point or time.
A charge of explosive for a firearm or for blasting.
examples: The truck was carrying a heavy load.
I have a huge load of work to do.
The power grid experienced a peak load.
He put a load in the rifle.
